title: Lasagne with Baby Spinach, Goat's Feta and Torn Mozzarella
subtitle: a quick one-tray lasagne
description: Fresh lasagne sheets boiled with spinach, then baked with garlic, mozzarella, goat's feta and oregano until the cheeses bubble and turn golden.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C on the top grill setting.
Bring water to the boil in a large pot and salt it. When boiling, tear in the lasagne sheets and cook for 2 minutes over high heat. Add the spinach and cook for 1 more minute.
Drain everything and transfer the pasta and spinach to a large baking dish.
Add the chopped garlic, the torn mozzarella, crumbled feta and oregano leaves to the dish, season with salt and pepper and mix. Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 15 minutes until the cheeses are bubbling and golden. Serve hot.
